name: Cyclistic Bike-share Capstone
tagline: Google Data Analytics capstone: how casual riders and members use the bikes
description: Analyzed a year of Cyclistic bike-share data to understand how casual riders and annual members use the bikes differently. sourceNote: Part of the Google Data Analytics Certificate. Full write-up with charts on Medium.
